tone.notes: Calm, precise narration with honest rounding ('about', 'almost', 'around'); no hype words; the kicker calls back the hook. Fits a 13+ curious audience.

banned_topics.notes: Pure arithmetic about time plus one prehistory fact (farming). Nothing about money, gambling, disasters, health, politics or religion.

visuals.notes: Every sentence gets its own scene; numbers on signs match the voiceover; title on one line inside the safe area; one-word captions sit above Dot's head and never cover a face. Signs stay inside the picture during camera moves.

character.notes: Dot is on-model (beige round head, tuft, orange scarf) in every frame; mouth moves with the voice. Minor: the 'worried'/'thinking' brows read slightly cross at phone size.

learnings: One scene per sentence with the number on a sign works: viewers see each figure as it is said — keep it.
Short first sentence ('A billion seconds.') lands the hook at ~1.3 s; reuse that pattern.
Use 'surprised' or 'curious' rather than 'worried'/'thinking' for Dot when the line is wonder, not concern — those brows read as cross at phone size.
